label: Physics V.1 supports change of a persisting subject
note: The elimination of generation and corruption singles out change between affirmative termini as motion. The route must show that its ChangesBetween instances with LivesAt at both endpoints are precisely changes between the relevant affirmative termini of one subject, with motion in the same respect. Aristotelian motion is restricted to the admitted kinds in this passage. The claim does not generalize that scope to every supplied respect.
